Naranjo of La Mirada, Calif., and their company, New Golden Investment Group, LLC, also of West Covina, with fraud and misappropriation in connection with a multi-million dollar Ponzi scheme.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Files Anti-Fraud Action against Jeffrey Shalhoub and Jeff Shalhoub Investments for Operating a Futures Ponzi Scheme Wed, 19 May 2010 17:24:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5826-10.html The CFTC charged Jeffrey Shalhoub of Staten Island, N.Y., and his company, Jeff Shalhoub Investments of Long Island City, N.Y., with operating a commodity futures Ponzi scheme.  


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Orders More than $3.8 Million in Sanctions against North Carolina Defendant Tyrone McCall and Two Entities He Controlled to Settle a CFTC Anti-Fraud Action Tue, 04 May 2010 16:06:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5818-10.html The CFTC obtained more than $3.8 million in civil money penalties and equitable relief in court orders against Tyrone “Cauzae” McCall and entities he controlled, McCall Business Group, LLC and MBG Global, LLC, both of Charlotte, N.C.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases The CFTC Sanctions Noble Americas Corp. $130,000 for Wash Sales Trading on the New York Mercantile Exchange and Causing Non Bona Fide Prices to Be Reported Mon, 03 May 2010 16:31:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5817-10.html The CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneous settling charges against Noble Americas Corp. for entering into commodity futures trades and exchange for physical (EFP) trades in heating oil and gasoline on the New York Mercantile Exchange and Globex that were wash and fictitious sales on several occasions during the period of March 30, 2007, through July 30, 2007.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Morgan Stanley Capital Group, Inc. to Pay a $14 Million Civil Penalty to Settle CFTC Charges that the Company Concealed a Large Block Crude Oil Trade Thu, 29 Apr 2010 21:25:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5816-10.html The CFTC announced the separate filings and simultaneous settlements of charges against Morgan Stanley Capital Group, Inc. and UBS Securities Inc. in connection with Morgan Stanley concealing from the New York Mercantile Exchange the existence of a large Trade at Settlement (TAS) block crude oil trade and UBS Securities aiding and abetting that concealment.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Hedge Fund Moore Capital Management, LP, and Its Affiliates Moore Capital Advisors, LLC and Moore Advisors, Ltd., Ordered to Pay a $25 Million Penalty to Settle CFTC Charges of Attempted Manipulation of Platinum and Palladium Futures Settlement Prices Thu, 29 Apr 2010 21:20:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5815-10.html The CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges that Moore Capital Management,


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Carmine Garofalo with Illegal Trading on a U.S. Exchange Thu, 22 Apr 2010 17:44:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5813-10.html The CFTC charged Carmine Garofalo, an Italian citizen, with options fraud, engaging in fictitious transactions and trading noncompetitively in violation of the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases San Diego Gas & Electric Company Agrees to Pay a Civil Penalty to Settle CFTC Charge that it Engaged in Wash Sales in the Natural Gas Futures Markets Thu, 22 Apr 2010 15:12:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5812-10.html The CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against San Diego Gas & Electric Company, an investor-owned regulated utility, in San Diego, Calif., for engaging in wash sales of New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures contracts.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Charleston, South Carolina-based Defendants Ordered to Pay More than $3.9 Million in Restitution and Civil Penalties to Resolve 2008 CFTC Anti-Fraud Action Thu, 15 Apr 2010 15:26:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5805-10.html The CFTC obtained more than $3.9 million in restitution and civil monetary penalties in a federal judgment order against CSA Trading Group, Inc. and Michael Derrick Peninger, both of Charleston, S.C., in a CFTC anti-fraud action.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Florida Resident Claudio Aliaga and His Company, CMA Capital Management, LLC, with Operating a Foreign Currency Ponzi Scheme Mon, 12 Apr 2010 17:08:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5807-10.html The CFTC charged Claudio Aliaga, of Davie, Fla., and his company, CMA Capital Management, LLC, of Miami Lakes, Fla., with operating a Ponzi scheme involving the fraudulent solicitation of at least $4.5 million from at least 125 individuals to invest in foreign currency (forex) managed accounts and/or a pooled investment.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Files Enforcement Action against Singapore National Kuen Cheol Song for Engaging in an Illegal Trading Scheme Mon, 12 Apr 2010 14:22:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5806-10.html The CFTC charged Kuen Cheol Song, a citizen of Singapore, with engaging in fictitious transactions and trading noncompetitively in violation of the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Sues Virginia-based Financial Investments, Inc. for Repeatedly Failing to File Annual Reports in a Timely Manner for a Commodity Pool It Operated Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5789-10.html The CFTC filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia charging Financial Investments, Inc. with repeatedly failing to distribute and file its commodity pool’s annual reports in a timely manner. $urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Imposes a $1 Million Penalty on California Resident Craig A. Riley and His Firm, Pressio Capital Management, LP, for Commodity Pool Fraud Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5781-10.html The CFTC issued an order imposing a $1 million penalty against Craig A. Riley of Ladera Ranch, Calif. and his firm, Pressio Capital Management, LP, for fraudulently operating a commodity pool and misappropriating pool participant funds.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases The CFTC Sanctions Swiss Firm $130,000 for Exceeding Position Limits Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5783-10.html The CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against UBS AG, a publicly traded Swiss corporation based in Basel, Switzerland, for exceeding the New York Mercantile Exchange’s (NYMEX) position limits on certain NYMEX natural gas, heating oil and platinum futures contracts on more than one occasion from in or about December 2006 through in or about March 2008.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Virginia Resident Ronald W. Smith, Jr., Doing Business as Safeguard 3030 Investment Club, in Forex Fraud Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5784-10.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today charged Ronald W. Smith, Jr., of Vansant, Va., doing business as Safeguard 3030 Investment Club, with operating a Ponzi scheme involving the fraudulent solicitation of at least $800,000 from at least 34 customers in connection with off-exchange foreign currency (forex) trading.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Issues Preliminary Injunction against Jay Nolan and His Company, Lodge Capital Group, LLC, Charged with Commodity Pool Fraud Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5785-10.html The CFTC obtained a preliminary injunction against defendants Jay C. Nolan of Wilmette, Ill. and his company, Lodge Capital Group, LLC, based in Northfield, Ill.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Orders Forex Dealer One World Capital Group and Its President, John “Jack” Edward Walsh, to Pay $520,000 in Sanctions Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5786-10.html The CFTC obtained an order against defendants One World Capital Group, LLC of Winnetka, Ill. and John Edward Walsh, of Lake Forest, Ill., requiring each to pay a $260,000 civil monetary penalty for failing to demonstrate compliance with CFTC net capital requirements.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases New York Court Imposes Fine and Other Sanctions against Robert Moore, Former Managing Director of the Bank of Montreal’s Commodity Derivatives Group Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5788-10.html The CFTC announced that it has entered into a consent order settling charges brought against Robert Moore of Connecticut, former executive managing director for the Bank of Montreal’s (BMO) Commodity Derivatives Group, relating to the mis-marking and mis-valuing of BMO’s natural gas options book by the trader he supervised.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Orders California Man David Michael Kogan and His Company, First Capitol Futures Group, to Pay More than $20.3 Million in CFTC Commodity Options Fraud Action Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5790-10.html The CFTC obtained more than $20.3 million in civil monetary penalties and equity relief in a federal judgment order against David Michael Kogan and his company, First Capitol Futures Group (a/k/a and d/b/a First Capital Group), both of Sherman Oaks, Calif., in a CFTC anti-fraud action.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Texas Resident Willie L. Cloud, Jr. and His Investment Company, C & R Financial, with Operating a Foreign Currency Ponzi Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5791-10.html The CFTC charged Willie L. Cloud, Jr. and his investment company, C & R Financial, Inc., both of Houston, Texas, with operating a Ponzi scheme in connection with foreign currency (forex) trading.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Issues Preliminary Injunction against Virginia Resident Ronald W. Smith, Jr., Doing Business as Safeguard 3030 Investment Club, in Forex Fraud Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5793-10.html The CFTC obtained a preliminary injunction against defendant Ronald W. Smith, Jr., d/b/a Safeguard 3030 Investment Club, of Vansant, Virginia, after a federal court held at hearing where the defendant also appeared.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Scottsdale, Arizona Resident Helmut H. Weber d/b/a Weber Capital Management with Solicitation Fraud and Misappropriation in Forex Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5794-10.html The CFTC filed a complaint against Helmut H. Weber d/b/a Weber Capital Management (WCM) of Scottsdale, Arizona, charging Weber with operating a fraudulent off-exchange foreign currency (forex) scheme.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Raleigh, North Carolina Man and His Company, Yellowstone Partners, Inc., with Operating a Foreign Currency Ponzi Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5795-10.html The CFTC announced that it charged Dennis Todd Hagemann and Yellowstone Partners, Inc., both of Raleigh, N.C., with operating a Ponzi scheme involving the fraudulent solicitation of at least $700,000 from at least nine individuals to trade foreign currency futures (forex) managed accounts and/or a pooled investment.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Patrick Rakotonanahary and Cyber Market Group LLC with Operating a Multi-Million Dollar Ponzi Scheme in Hawaii and Elsewhere in the U.S. Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5797-10.html The CFTC charged Patrick Rakotonanahary and Cyber Market Group LLC (Cyber Market), both of Punta Gorda, Fla., with operating a multi-million dollar foreign currency (forex) Ponzi scheme in Hawaii and elsewhere in the United States.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Federal Court Imposes $260,000 in Civil Penalties against Austin, Texas Resident Steven Leigh Shakespeare and His Company, Guardian Futures, Inc., Both Charged with Fraud and Unauthorized Trading Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5799-10.html The CFTC obtained $260,000 in civil monetary penalties and equitable relief in separate federal judgment orders against Steven Leigh Shakespeare and his company, Guardian Futures, Inc., an Austin, Texas introducing broker, in a CFTC anti-fraud action.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Georgia-Based Hedge Fund Lake Dow and its Principal, Ty Edwards, Ordered to Pay More than $4 million in Restitution and Penalties in CFTC Commodity Pool Fraud Action Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5800-10.html The CFTC obtained more than $4 million in restitution and civil monetary penalties in an order entered by the U.S. District Court for the Northern Division of Georgia against defendants Lake Dow Capital, LLC and Ty Edwards in CFTC v. Lake Dow, LLC, et al., a CFTC enforcement action filed in October 2005.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Ohio-based Defendants Enrique Villalba, Jr., and Money Market Alternative, LP, with Operating a Multi-Million Dollar Futures Ponzi Scheme Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5801-10.html The CFTC charged Enrique F. Villalba, Jr., of Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio, and his firm, Money Market Alternative, LP, an Ohio company, with operating a multi-million dollar commodity futures Ponzi scheme.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Charlottesville, Virginia-based Defendants Ordered to Pay More than $4.6 Million in Disgorgement and Civil Penalties to Settle 2009 CFTC Anti-Fraud Action Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5802-10.html The CFTC obtained more than $4.6 million in disgorgement and civil monetary penalties in a court order settling CFTC charges filed on March 11, 2009, against defendants John M. Donnelly, Tower Analysis Inc., Nasco Tang Corp. and Nadia Capital Corp., all of Charlottesville, Va., and relief defendants Blue Logic Operating Partners LP, Nadia Capital Operating Partners LP and Deborah B Donnelly.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases Minnesota Resident Trevor Cook Incarcerated for Violating Court Orders in CFTC Anti-Fraud Action Charging Him in $190 Million Foreign Currency Fraud Fri, 29 Jan 2010 15:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5779-10.html The CFTC announced that Minnesota federal Chief Judge Michael J. Davis incarcerated CFTC defendant Trevor G. Cook on January 25, 2010, for violating the court’s asset freeze order against him by dissipating funds and failing to surrender more than $35 million in assets.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases CFTC Charges Illinois Defendants Jay C. Nolan and His Company, Lodge Capital Group, LLC, with Commodity Pool Fraud Fri, 29 Jan 2010 14:46:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5778-10.html The CFTC announced that it obtained an emergency federal court order freezing the assets of defendants Jay C. Nolan of Wilmette, Ill. and his company, Lodge Capital Group, LLC, an Illinois limited liability company based in Northfield, Ill.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases The CFTC Sanctions Toronto-Based Scotia Capital Inc. $250,000 for Prearranged Fictitious Trades Thu, 28 Jan 2010 16:29:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5777-10.html CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against Scotia Capital Inc. for prearranging trades in the natural gas futures contract on the New York Mercantile Exchange during November and December of 2006.


$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http//qa.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases The CFTC Sanctions Two Canadian Firms $500,000 for Entering into Unlawful Wash Sales Thu, 28 Jan 2010 15:51:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5776-10.html The CFTC issued an order filing and simultaneously settling charges against Pinemore, L.P. and Birchmore, L.P., two Canadian limited partnerships based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, for engaging in unlawful wash sales in the natural gas futures contract on the New York Mercantile Exchange during November and December of 2006.
